name: Deep Reflectance Volumes
definition: A deep learning approach to reconstruct scene appearance from unstructured images captured under collocated point lighting, using a volumetric scene representation consisting of opacity, surface normal, and reflectance voxel grids.
summary: Deep Reflectance Volumes is a differentiable rendering method that reconstructs complex materials and hard shadows by learning global opacity and pervoxel reflectance from unstructured images under collocated point lighting.
